Deploying Ollama locally seems like a straightforward process, but there are three unexpected issues you might encounter. Here’s a record of them.
Pit 1: Direct Download from Official Website Fails Symptoms: Accessing https://ollama.com/download/OllamaSetup.exe results in PowerShell errors such as Could not resolve host: github.com or Unable to connect to remote server.
Cause: The Ollama official website is just a redirect page, and the actual installation package is hosted on GitHub Releases. Accessing GitHub from domestic networks is unstable and unreliable.
Solution:
First, get the latest version number from https://api.github.com/repos/ollama/ollama/releases/latest. Add a mirror prefix to the GitHub download link, for example: https://ghproxy.net/https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/download/vX.Y.Z/OllamaSetup.exe Use curl or a browser to download the file and verify its size (Ollama installation package is approximately 1.4GB). Pit 2: Default Listening Only on 127.0.0.1, Unreachable from Other Devices Symptoms: Ollama runs successfully, but http://192.168.x.x:11434/api/tags cannot be accessed from other devices, while curl http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags works fine on the local machine.
Cause: By default, Ollama sets OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1 for security reasons, which does not expose the service to the local network.
Solution (Run as Administrator in PowerShell):
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('OLLAMA_HOST','0.0.0.0','User') Then, restart the Ollama service for the changes to take effect. In Task Manager, end all ollama.exe processes and restart the Ollama application.
Use netstat -ano | findstr 11434 to confirm that the listening address has changed to 0.0.0.0:11434.
Pit 3: Environment Variable Set but Not Read by Service Symptoms: After setting OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0, Ollama still listens on 127.0.0.1 after a restart.
Cause: The Ollama Windows version is a tray application (ollama app.exe), and it starts with the environment variables set at login time. After modifying the user-level environment variable, the tray application must be completely closed (right-click the tray icon → Quit) and restarted. Only restarting the command line ollama serve inherits the current shell environment, but the tray application does not.
Solution:
Check Task Manager to ensure there are no lingering ollama.exe processes. Restart Ollama from the Start Menu. Use netstat to verify. Pit 4: Windows Firewall Blocks External Access Symptoms: The local machine can access http://192.168.x.x:11434, but mobile devices cannot.
Cause: The Windows Defender Firewall blocks external inbound connections to port 11434 by default.
Solution (Run as Administrator in PowerShell):
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "Ollama" -Direction Inbound -LocalPort 11434 -Protocol TCP -Action Allow To open only to the local network for security:
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "Ollama LAN" -Direction Inbound -LocalPort 11434 -Protocol TCP -RemoteAddress 192.168.0.0/16 -Action Allow Summary The four issues are not bugs in Ollama itself but rather common obstacles when exposing a local service to the network on Windows. Follow this sequence: use a mirror for downloading → change OLLAMA_HOST → completely restart → allow firewall rules. Once you’ve encountered these issues, you can resolve them in about 10 minutes next time.

部署本地 Ollama 看起来是一件"下一步下一步"的事，但实际会遇到三个不写出来你想不到的坑。记录一下。
坑 1：官网下载直连 GitHub 失败 症状：访问 https://ollama.com/download/OllamaSetup.exe，PowerShell 报 Could not resolve host: github.com 或 无法连接到远程服务器。
原因：Ollama 官网只是个跳转页，真正的安装包托管在 GitHub Release。国内网络访问 GitHub 不稳定，时好时坏。
解法：
先 https://api.github.com/repos/ollama/ollama/releases/latest 拿最新版本号 在 GitHub 下载链接前加镜像前缀，如： https://ghproxy.net/https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/download/vX.Y.Z/OllamaSetup.exe 用 curl 或浏览器下载，验证文件大小（Ollama 安装包约 1.4GB） 坑 2：默认只监听 127.0.0.1，手机/其他电脑访问不到 症状：Ollama 跑起来了，本机 curl http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags 正常，但 http://192.168.x.x:11434/api/tags 直接拒绝连接。
原因：Ollama 默认 OLLAMA_HOST=127.0.0.1，出于安全考虑不开放到局域网。
解法（PowerShell 管理员）：
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('OLLAMA_HOST','0.0.0.0','User') 然后必须重启 Ollama 服务才生效。任务管理器里结束所有 ollama.exe 进程，再启动 Ollama 应用。
用 netstat -ano | findstr 11434 确认监听地址变成 0.0.0.0:11434。
坑 3：环境变量设置了但服务没读到 症状：设置了 OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0，重启 Ollama 后仍然监听 127.0.0.1。
原因：Ollama Windows 版是托盘应用（ollama app.exe），它启动时继承的是登录时的环境。改完用户级环境变量后，必须完全退出托盘应用（右键托盘图标 → Quit），再重新打开。仅重启命令行 ollama serve 会继承当前 shell 的环境，但托盘应用不会。
解法：
检查任务管理器，确保没有残留的 ollama.exe 进程 从开始菜单重新启动 Ollama 用 netstat 验证 坑 4：Windows 防火墙拦截外部访问 症状：本机用 http://192.168.x.x:11434 能通，但手机连不上。
原因：Windows Defender 防火墙默认阻止外部入站连接到 11434 端口。
解法（PowerShell 管理员）：
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "Ollama" -Direction Inbound -LocalPort 11434 -Protocol TCP -Action Allow 只对局域网开放更安全：
New-NetFirewallRule -DisplayName "Ollama LAN" -Direction Inbound -LocalPort 11434 -Protocol TCP -RemoteAddress 192.168.0.0/16 -Action Allow 小结 四个坑都不是 Ollama 本身的 bug，而是"本地服务暴露到网络"这件事在 Windows 上的常规障碍。按顺序：下载镜像 → 改 OLLAMA_HOST → 完全重启 → 防火墙放行。踩完一次，下次 10 分钟搞定。

Deploying Ollama and setting it up to auto-start on Windows can greatly enhance daily use. However, using the default command-line method may result in a black window popping up at each boot, affecting aesthetics and user experience. This article will provide a detailed guide on how to set up Ollama to auto-start on Windows without displaying a black window, ideal for users needing Ollama to run continuously.
Installing Ollama First, you need to install Ollama on your Windows system. Visit the Ollama official website or related resource pages to download the appropriate installation package for Windows. Follow the official documentation to complete the installation steps, ensuring that Ollama is correctly installed.
Preparing the Run Script To avoid the black window, we need to prepare a run script. Create a new text file named run_ollama.bat, and add the following content:
@echo off start /b "" "C:\Path\To\Ollama.exe" Make sure to replace C:\Path\To\Ollama.exe with the actual path to the Ollama executable file. The start /b parameter is used to start the program in the background without displaying the command prompt window.
Creating a Windows Service Next, we need to use the sc command to create a Windows service to manage Ollama’s startup. Open the command prompt and enter the following command:
sc create OllamaService binPath= "C:\Path\To\run_ollama.bat" Ensure that C:\Path\To\run_ollama.bat is replaced with the actual path to the run script. After creating the service, you can use the following command to set it to auto-start:
sc config OllamaService start= auto Verification and Testing After completing the above steps, restart your computer and check if Ollama auto-starts without displaying a black window. If everything is set up correctly, you should see Ollama running in the background.
Configuration Optimization For further optimization, consider using Task Scheduler to periodically check if Ollama is running normally and automatically restart it if the process does not exist. Create a new task with the trigger set to “At startup” and the action set to start the Ollama run script.
<Triggers> <BootTrigger /> </Triggers> <Actions> <Exec> <Command>C:\Path\To\run_ollama.bat</Command> </Exec> </Actions> Conclusion By following the above steps, you can set up Ollama to auto-start on Windows without displaying a black window, ensuring continuous and stable operation while enhancing the system’s aesthetics and user experience. I hope this article is helpful to you.

问题 12GB 显存跑 14B 模型，到底能开多大上下文？这是部署本地大模型时最关心的问题之一。本文用真实数据回答。
测试环境 显卡：RTX 4070 SUPER（12GB） 模型：Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct，Q4_K_M 量化，权重约 9GB 推理引擎：Ollama 0.34 监控命令：ollama ps 实测数据 上下文长度 (num_ctx) 模型占用 GPU/CPU 比例 推理速度 4096 9.5 GB 100% GPU ~49 tok/s 16384 ~11 GB 100% GPU（临界） ~40 tok/s 32768 ~15 GB 34% CPU + 66% GPU ~15-20 tok/s 65536 爆显存 大量 CPU 不可用 原理 14B Q4 的权重约 9GB。剩下的 3GB 显存要放：
KV cache：每 1K token 上下文约占几百 MB（取决于模型层数和隐藏维度） 激活值和临时缓冲 上下文越长，KV cache 越大。超过显存容量后，Ollama 会自动把部分层放到系统内存，通过 PCIe 交换数据——这就是为什么速度突然腰斩。
实用建议 日常对话用 4096-8192 上下文：绝大多数聊天场景够了，速度最快。 长文档分析用 16384：12G 显存临界值，还能跑满 GPU。 代码/Agent 用 32768：必须的话，接受 CPU 混合的速度下降。 别盲目开 128K：Qwen2.5 原生支持 128K 上下文，但那需要几十 GB 显存。 怎么调整上下文长度 Ollama 端通过 num_ctx 参数控制。在 OpenClaw 里配置：
{ "params": { "num_ctx": 16384, "keep_alive": "15m" } } 或直接在 Ollama 的 Modelfile 里设置。
小结 12GB 显存跑 14B 模型的甜蜜点是 8K-16K 上下文。想要长上下文要么换更大显存（24G+），要么接受 CPU 混合的速度代价。本地模型不是越大越好，合适的才是对的。

Problem How much context can a 12GB VRAM handle when running a 14B model? This is one of the most critical questions when deploying large models locally. This article answers it with real data.
Test Environment GPU: RTX 4070 SUPER (12GB) Model: Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct, Q4_K_M quantization, weights around 9GB Inference Engine: Ollama 0.34 Monitoring Command: ollama ps Practical Measurements Context Length (num_ctx) Model Usage GPU/CPU Ratio Inference Speed 4096 9.5 GB 100% GPU ~49 tok/s 16384 ~11 GB 100% GPU (critical) ~40 tok/s 32768 ~15 GB 34% CPU + 66% GPU ~15-20 tok/s 65536 VRAM overflow Mostly CPU Unavailable Principles The weights of a 14B Q4 model are around 9GB. The remaining 3GB VRAM must accommodate:
KV cache: Approximately hundreds of MB per 1K token context (depends on model layers and hidden dimensions) Activation values and temporary buffers The longer the context, the larger the KV cache. Once VRAM capacity is exceeded, Ollama automatically moves some layers to system memory, exchanging data via PCIe, which is why the speed drops significantly.
Practical Recommendations Use 4096-8192 context for daily conversations: Sufficient for most chat scenarios, and the fastest. Use 16384 for long document analysis: Critical value for 12GB VRAM, still runs full GPU. Use 32768 for code/Agent: Accept the speed penalty of CPU hybrid if necessary. Avoid blindly setting 128K: Qwen2.5 natively supports 128K context, but that requires tens of GB VRAM. How to Adjust Context Length Controlled via the num_ctx parameter in Ollama. Configure in OpenClaw:
{ "params": { "num_ctx": 16384, "keep_alive": "15m" } } Or set directly in Ollama’s Modelfile.
Conclusion The sweet spot for running a 14B model with 12GB VRAM is 8K-16K context. For longer contexts, either upgrade to larger VRAM (24GB+), or accept the speed trade-off of CPU hybrid. Larger models aren’t always better; the right size is key.

What is OpenClaw OpenClaw is an open-source AI Agent Gateway that runs on your own machine, connecting chat channels (Telegram, Discord, Lark, Web UI, etc.) to large models. It is licensed under MIT and has over 100,000 stars on GitHub.
Its value lies in: you send a message, it calls the model, executes tools, maintains sessions, and retains memory—essentially, it upgrades “ollama in the command line” into a truly functional assistant.
System Requirements Node.js ≥ 24.16 (Note: Node 22 LTS is insufficient and will be rejected by the preinstall script) Windows 10/11 A local or remote Ollama instance Installation Steps 1. Install Node.js 24 Download the Windows zip version from nodejs.org, extract it to C:\nodejs, and add it to the user PATH.
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('Path', "$env:Path;C:\nodejs", 'User') 2. Install OpenClaw Globally npm install -g openclaw@latest Pitfall 1: npm 11 introduces a allow-scripts security mechanism that defaults to skipping postinstall scripts for native modules like koffi. You must execute:
npm install -g --allow-scripts=openclaw,@google/genai,koffi,tree-sitter-bash,protobufjs openclaw@latest Otherwise, the startup will fail due to missing native bindings.
3. Configure Local Ollama Edit C:\Users\<you>\.openclaw\openclaw.json:
{ "gateway": { "mode": "local" }, "models": { "providers": { "ollama": { "baseUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:11434", "models": [ { "id": "qwen2.5:14b", "contextWindow": 32768, "params": { "num_ctx": 32768, "keep_alive": "15m" } } ] } } }, "agents": { "defaults": { "model": { "primary": "ollama/qwen2.5:14b" } } } } Pitfall 2: The OpenClaw Ollama provider must use the native API (baseUrl without /v1). Using the OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint will cause tool calls to fail.
Pitfall 3: Not writing the API key in the configuration file is not enough—it exists in the local SQLite authentication database. The first run requires:
"ollama-local" | openclaw models auth paste-api-key --provider ollama 4. Start the Gateway openclaw gateway install # Install to start on boot openclaw gateway restart Open your browser and visit http://127.0.0.1:18789/, log in with the token output by openclaw gateway auth-token --show, and you can chat in the Web UI.
Performance Test With qwen2.5:14b as the backend, on a machine with 12GB of VRAM:
Normal conversations run 100% on GPU, approximately 49 tok/s Long context (32K) will partially spill over to memory, reducing speed Agent mode (with tool calls) is fully functional, but the 14B model’s understanding of complex multi-step toolchains is inferior to that of GPT-4-level models Conclusion OpenClaw is currently the most straightforward solution for turning local models into “real assistants”. The deployment process is more challenging than expected (Node version, npm security mechanisms, context window size issues), but once set up, it becomes a fully functional, self-starting local agent that can be accessed via Web UI and connected to Telegram/Lark.
summary:
What is OpenClaw

OpenClaw is an open-source AI Agent Gateway that runs on your own machine, connecting chat channels (Telegram, Discord, Lark, Web UI, etc.) to large models. It is licensed under MIT and has over 100,000 stars on GitHub.

Its value lies in: you send a message, it calls the model, executes tools, maintains sessions, and retains memory—essentially, it upgrades “ollama in the command line” into a truly functional assistant.

content:
Hardware and Conclusion Item Configuration GPU RTX 4070 SUPER (12GB VRAM) Model Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct (Q4_K_M quantization, approximately 9GB) Software Ollama for Windows 0.34 Performance Approximately 49 tokens/s after warm-up (100% GPU) Conclusion: 12GB VRAM is sufficient for running 14B Q4 models. The model itself is about 9GB, and with the context KV cache, it does not exceed VRAM capacity.
Step 1: Install Ollama Download the Windows installer from ollama.com/download and run it silently by double-clicking.
Troubleshooting Tip: The official website hosts the installer on GitHub Releases. If you are in China and direct access fails with “Could not resolve host: github.com”, use a GitHub mirror (such as ghproxy) to retry.
After installation, open cmd to verify:
ollama --version Step 2: Pull the Model ollama pull qwen2.5:14b The model is approximately 9GB, and the download speed depends on your network. Confirm the download with ollama list.
Step 3: Validate Inference ollama run qwen2.5:14b Enter a sentence directly to test. The first inference will load the model into VRAM, taking about 10-20 seconds.
Step 4: Open Local Network Access (Optional) By default, Ollama only listens on 127.0.0.1:11434, which is not accessible from other devices. Set the environment variable and restart:
[Environment]::SetEnvironmentVariable('OLLAMA_HOST','0.0.0.0','User','User') After restarting the Ollama service, local network devices can access the API via http://<your LAN IP>:11434.
VRAM Usage Testing Context Length GPU Usage Speed 4096 100% GPU ~49 tok/s 32768 34% CPU + 66% GPU Significantly slower With 12GB VRAM, the KV cache space is limited after loading 14B Q4. Longer contexts will overflow to memory, reducing speed. 4K context is sufficient for daily conversations.
Final Thoughts Running a 14B model locally is not about being “better than GPT-4”, but about: no data leaving the machine, no API fees, offline use, and customizable settings. If you have a card with more than 12GB VRAM, this step is worth taking.
